These programs are accredited by the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) and the National Computing Education Accreditation Council (NCEAC), ensuring they meet national and international quality standards. The curriculum is structured to build a strong foundation in engineering theory, mathematics, and applied sciences in the early years, progressively moving toward specialized technical knowledge, laboratory work, design projects, and industry exposure in the later semesters. Students are required to complete a final-year project that addresses a real engineering problem, encouraging innovation and independent thinking. Throughout the program, emphasis is placed on developing analytical reasoning, teamwork, communication skills, and professional ethics.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: Graduates of these programs are well-equipped to pursue careers across the public and private sectors, enter postgraduate studies locally or abroad, or establish their own ventures in the engineering and technology space. UET Admission — Guidance for Preference Selection English اردو Basic Application Procedure: First, candidates should print the challan form and submit the fee according to the given instructions. After fee submission, candidates must log in to the admission portal and complete the application form. Selection of program preferences is an important part of the admission process; therefore preferences should be selected very carefully. Admission to UET depends upon the preferences selected by the candidate. Eligibility Requirements: Admission tests are compulsory for Engineering and Computing programs, while Science and Business programs do not require an admission test. For Computing Science and Business programs, candidates must have at least 50% marks in Intermediate or equivalent qualification, whereas Engineering programs require at least 60% marks in Intermediate or equivalent qualification.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: In addition, every program requires specific subjects in Intermediate or equivalent studies. Candidates who have not studied the required subjects will be considered ineligible for that program. Candidates are advised to check their eligibility on the admission portal because admission may be cancelled at any stage if eligibility conditions are not fulfilled. Programs and Campuses: Candidates may select multiple programs from different campuses in a single application, provided they meet the eligibility criteria for those programs. Each program will be counted as a separate preference. Program Categories: UET offers different admission categories. For candidates holding Punjab domicile, A1 and A2 categories are commonly available. The fee for A1 is lower and is approximately 35% less than A2. Candidates are advised to select all categories for which they are eligible because this increases the chances of admission. Apart from A1 and A2, other categories are also available, which candidates may choose according to their eligibility. Eligibility for these categories can be checked on the admission website. Rules for Preference Selection: The order of preferences is very important.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: Candidates should place their most preferred program and campus at the top and should not rely only on previous merit trends. Preferences should always be selected according to personal interest and career goals, and all eligible categories should be included. During admission processing, the university first attempts to offer admission in the first preference. If admission is not possible there, the second preference is considered, and the process continues in the same order for all preferences. Admission Allocation Procedure: Admission is granted only in the preference where the candidate meets the required merit. Once selection is made in one preference, all lower preferences automatically expire. However, if the candidate submits the fee, they may still be considered for higher preferences in future merit lists. Important Instructions: Candidates are considered only for those programs and categories that they have selected. If a program is not selected, admission will not be offered in that program even if the candidate’s merit is high enough.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: Fee and Document Submission: If the fee and required documents are not submitted after selection, the candidate will be excluded from all future merit lists. Therefore, candidates are advised to choose preferences carefully and submit the fee on time. Important Guidance Candidates should select preferences wisely, include all eligible categories, keep the order of preferences clear, and ensure timely submission of fee and required documents.

chunks.text: Preparation of Required Documents: At the time of admission, candidates must keep the following original documents ready for verification: · CNIC / B-Form / Identity Card · Domicile Certificate · Matric Certificate or Equivalent Degree · Intermediate Result Card / A&O Levels / DAE / B.Tech or Equivalent Qualification · Any category-related documents, according to the selected category Offer Letter Download and Reporting: When a candidate’s name appears in the merit list, they must download the offer letter from the admission portal. It is mandatory to carefully read all instructions mentioned in the offer letter. Candidates must appear at the designated center along with all required documents. After completion of the verification and checking process, the university will issue the fee challan and admission file. Completion of Admission File and Fee Submission: Candidates must complete all documents in the admission file according to the given instructions and submit the required fee before the deadline through the issued challan. Proof of fee submission must also be attached with the admission file.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: Receipt Collection and Admission Confirmation: Admission will only be considered confirmed after the candidate receives the official admission receipt. Without the receipt, admission will not be treated as finalized, and the seat may be offered to another candidate in the next merit list. Candidates can obtain the receipt after submitting the complete admission file along with proof of fee payment before the deadline mentioned in the offer letter. Important Note: If a candidate fails to submit the required fee and necessary documents before the final deadline after receiving the admission offer letter, or fails to obtain the admission receipt after document submission, the admission will be considered cancelled. Such candidates will be removed from the admission list and will not be considered in any future merit lists.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: امیدواروں کو مشورہ دیا جاتا ہے کہ وہ باقاعدگی سے داخلہ پورٹل کو اعلان کردہ شیڈول کے مطابق چیک کرتے رہیں تاکہ اپنی میرٹ اسٹیٹس اور داخلہ کی پیش رفت سے باخبر رہ سکیں۔ ضروری دستاویزات کی تیاری: داخلے کے وقت امیدواروں کو تصدیق کے لیے درج ذیل اصل دستاویزات تیار رکھنی ہوں گی: · CNIC / B-Form / شناختی کارڈ · ڈومیسائل سرٹیفکیٹ · میٹرک سرٹیفکیٹ یا مساوی ڈگری · انٹرمیڈیٹ رزلٹ کارڈ / اے اینڈ او لیولز / DAE / B.Tech یا مساوی قابلیت · منتخب کردہ کیٹیگری کے مطابق دیگر متعلقہ دستاویزات آفر لیٹر ڈاؤن لوڈ اور رپورٹنگ: جب کسی امیدوار کا نام میرٹ لسٹ میں آ جائے تو اسے داخلہ پورٹل سے آفر لیٹر ڈاؤن لوڈ کرنا ہوگا۔ آفر لیٹر میں دی گئی تمام ہدایات کو غور سے پڑھنا لازمی ہے۔ امیدواروں کو مقررہ مرکز پر تمام مطلوبہ دستاویزات کے ساتھ حاضر ہونا ہوگا۔ تصدیق اور جانچ پڑتال کے بعد یونیورسٹی فیس چالان اور داخلہ فائل جاری کرے گی۔ داخلہ فائل کی تکمیل اور فیس جمع کرانا: امیدواروں کو داخلہ فائل میں تمام دستاویزات دی گئی ہدایات کے مطابق مکمل کرنی ہوں گی اور جاری کردہ چالان کے ذریعے مقررہ تاریخ سے پہلے مطلوبہ فیس جمع کرانی ہوگی۔ فیس جمع کروانے کا ثبوت بھی داخلہ فائل کے ساتھ منسلک کرنا ہوگا۔ رسید کا حصول اور داخلہ کی تصدیق: داخلہ صرف اس وقت حتمی تصور کیا جائے گا جب امیدوار کو یونیورسٹی کی جانب سے باضابطہ داخلہ رسید موصول ہو جائے۔ رسید کے بغیر داخلہ مکمل تصور نہیں کیا جائے گا اور نشست اگلی میرٹ لسٹ میں کسی اور امیدوار کو دی جا سکتی ہے۔ امیدوار مقررہ آخری تاریخ سے پہلے مکمل داخلہ فائل اور فیس کی ادائیگی کے ثبوت جمع کرانے کے بعد رسید حاصل کر سکتے ہیں۔ اہم نوٹ: اگر کوئی امیدوار آفر لیٹر ملنے کے بعد مقررہ آخری تاریخ سے پہلے مطلوبہ فیس اور ضروری دستاویزات جمع نہیں کرواتا، یا دستاویزات جمع کروانے کے بعد داخلہ رسید حاصل کرنے میں ناکام رہتا ہے تو اس کا داخلہ منسوخ تصور کیا جائے گا۔ ایسے امیدواروں کو داخلہ لسٹ سے خارج کر دیا جائے گا اور وہ آئندہ کسی بھی میرٹ لسٹ میں شامل نہیں ہوں گے۔ Preference Change (For Candidates

chunks.text: Who Have Already Submitted Admission Fee and Documents) English اردو Eligibility for Preference Change: Candidates who have secured admission in any department up to the fourth merit list and have completely submitted their admission fee and required documents will be eligible to apply for a change of preferences or department through the admission portal.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: In case of submitting a new request, all previous preferences of the candidate will automatically be cancelled except for the department in which the candidate has already secured admission. Fee Submission and Application Process: Candidates are required to deposit a challan fee of Rs. 1500 within the prescribed schedule. After fee submission, candidates must log in to the admission portal and submit their application online. Only one preference addition or modification will be allowed. Seat Availability and Merit Criteria: The portal will display only those departments in which seats are available and for which the candidate meets the merit criteria. However, seat availability may change due to withdrawal of other candidates. Important Merit Policy: It should be clearly understood that submitting a preference request within the given time and meeting the closing merit of the fourth merit list does not guarantee admission in the desired department. All applications will be considered strictly on merit basis.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: Separate Merit List for Preference Change: A separate merit list for preference changes will be issued on the admission portal according to the schedule after the application deadline. The closing merit of this list may be higher than the fourth merit list because it depends on the number of applicants and the availability of seats in each department. Candidates Not Selected: Candidates who are not selected due to limited seats or higher merit of other applicants will continue to retain their admission in the department allotted under the fourth merit list.

chunks.text: ترجیحات (Preference) میں تبدیلی کے لیے اہلیت: وہ امیدوار جنہوں نے چوتھی میرٹ لسٹ تک کسی بھی شعبے میں داخلہ حاصل کر لیا ہو اور اپنی داخلہ فیس اور مطلوبہ دستاویزات مکمل طور پر جمع کروا دی ہوں، وہ داخلہ پورٹل کے ذریعے اپنی ترجیحات یا شعبہ تبدیل کرنے کے لیے درخواست دینے کے اہل ہوں گے۔ اگر کوئی نئی درخواست جمع کرائی جاتی ہے تو امیدوار کی تمام سابقہ ترجیحات خود بخود منسوخ ہو جائیں گی، سوائے اس شعبے کے جس میں پہلے ہی داخلہ حاصل کیا جا چکا ہے۔ فیس جمع کرانے اور درخواست کا طریقہ کار: امیدواروں کو مقررہ شیڈول کے اندر 1500 روپے فیس جمع کرانی ہوگی۔ فیس جمع کروانے کے بعد امیدواروں کو داخلہ پورٹل پر لاگ ان کرکے آن لائن درخواست جمع کرانی ہوگی۔ صرف ایک بار ترجیح (Preference) میں اضافہ یا تبدیلی کی اجازت ہوگی۔ سیٹوں کی دستیابی اور میرٹ کا معیار: پورٹل پر صرف وہی شعبے ظاہر کیے جائیں گے جن میں سیٹیں دستیاب ہوں گی اور جن کے لیے امیدوار میرٹ کے معیار پر پورا اترتا ہو۔ تاہم، سیٹوں کی دستیابی دوسرے امیدواروں کے داخلہ واپس لینے کی وجہ سے تبدیل ہو سکتی ہے۔ اہم میرٹ پالیسی: یہ واضح طور پر سمجھنا ضروری ہے کہ مقررہ وقت کے اندر ترجیح میں تبدیلی کی درخواست جمع کروانا اور چوتھی میرٹ لسٹ کے اختتامی میرٹ پر پورا اترنا مطلوبہ شعبے میں داخلے کی ضمانت نہیں دیتا۔ تمام درخواستوں کا فیصلہ مکمل طور پر میرٹ کی بنیاد پر کیا جائے گا۔ ترجیحات کی تبدیلی کے لیے علیحدہ میرٹ لسٹ: ترجیحات میں تبدیلی کے لیے ایک علیحدہ میرٹ لسٹ داخلہ پورٹل پر شیڈول کے مطابق درخواستوں کی آخری تاریخ کے بعد جاری کی جائے گی۔ اس لسٹ کا اختتامی میرٹ چوتھی میرٹ لسٹ سے زیادہ ہو سکتا ہے کیونکہ یہ درخواست دہندگان کی تعداد اور ہر شعبے میں دستیاب سیٹوں پر منحصر ہوگا۔ وہ امیدوار جو منتخب نہیں ہو سکے: وہ امیدوار جو محدود سیٹوں یا دوسرے امیدواروں کے زیادہ میرٹ کی وجہ سے منتخب نہیں ہو سکے، وہ چوتھی میرٹ لسٹ کے تحت دیے گئے اپنے موجودہ داخلے کو برقرار رکھیں گے۔ Leftover Candidates (Candidates Who Could Not Apply Earlier or Could Not Secure Admission)

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: English اردو Eligibility for Leftover Admission Opportunity: Candidates who could not apply earlier, could not secure admission because of their selected preferences, failed to report after their name appeared in the merit list, or failed to obtain the admission receipt will be given another opportunity if vacant seats are available.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: This process will begin after completion of the previous admission process. Challan Generation and Fee Submission: Candidates will have to generate a challan according to their status from the admission portal and submit it within the prescribed time. Existing candidates will pay Rs. 1500 while new candidates will pay Rs. 3000. Preference Addition Process: After fee submission, candidates can log in to the portal and add only one preference, provided seats are available in that department and the candidate’s merit falls within the closing merit of the fourth merit list. Merit List for Leftover Candidates: After submission of applications, a separate merit list for leftover candidates will be issued according to the announced schedule. The closing merit of this list may be higher than the fourth merit list. Final Admission Formalities: Selected candidates will have to submit the fee and report to the university within the prescribed period so that all admission formalities may be completed.

chunks.text: باقی رہ جانے والی نشستوں پر داخلہ کے مواقع کے لیے اہلیت: وہ امیدوار جو پہلے درخواست نہیں دے سکے، اپنی منتخب ترجیحات کی وجہ سے داخلہ حاصل نہیں کر سکے، جن کا نام میرٹ لسٹ میں آنے کے باوجود رپورٹ نہ کر سکے، یا جنہوں نے داخلہ رسید حاصل نہیں کی، انہیں خالی نشستوں کی دستیابی کی صورت میں دوبارہ موقع دیا جائے گا۔ یہ عمل سابقہ داخلہ عمل مکمل ہونے کے بعد شروع ہوگا۔ چالان جنریشن اور فیس جمع کرانے کا طریقہ کار: امیدواروں کو داخلہ پورٹل سے اپنی حیثیت کے مطابق چالان جنریٹ کرنا ہوگا اور مقررہ وقت کے اندر جمع کرانا ہوگا۔ موجودہ امیدوار 1500 روپے جبکہ نئے امیدوار 3000 روپے فیس ادا کریں گے۔ ترجیح (Preference) شامل کرنے کا طریقہ: فیس جمع کرانے کے بعد امیدوار پورٹل میں لاگ ان کرکے صرف ایک ترجیح (Preference) شامل کر سکتے ہیں، بشرطیکہ متعلقہ شعبے میں سیٹیں دستیاب ہوں اور امیدوار کا میرٹ چوتھی میرٹ لسٹ کے اختتامی میرٹ کے اندر آتا ہو۔ خالی نشستوں کے امیدواروں کے لیے میرٹ لسٹ: درخواستیں جمع ہونے کے بعد خالی نشستوں کے لیے امیدواروں کی ایک علیحدہ میرٹ لسٹ جاری کی جائے گی، جو اعلان کردہ شیڈول کے مطابق ہوگی۔ اس لسٹ کا اختتامی میرٹ چوتھی میرٹ لسٹ سے زیادہ ہو سکتا ہے۔ حتمی داخلہ کارروائی: منتخب امیدواروں کو مقررہ مدت کے اندر فیس جمع کرانی ہوگی اور یونیورسٹی میں رپورٹ کرنا ہوگا تاکہ تمام داخلہ کارروائی مکمل کی جا سکے۔ Walk-in Admissions English اردو Introduction to Walk-in Admissions: If some seats remain vacant even after completion of all admission phases, the process of walk-in admissions will be started to fill those seats.

chunks.title: Bachelors in Sciences - UET Admissions Portal
chunks.text: This process will continue for a maximum of three weeks after the commencement of classes or until all seats are filled. Application Submission Process: Interested candidates will have to submit an online application through the admission portal according to the announced schedule and generate a challan fee according to their status. Fee Structure: Existing candidates will pay Rs. 1500 while new candidates will pay Rs. 3000. The fee must be deposited in the designated bank. Validity of Application: After fee submission, the application will remain valid for one week. Merit List Announcement: Every Friday night, a list of selected candidates will be displayed on the admission portal. Selected candidates must submit the fee and report to the university within the prescribed time so that all admission formalities can be completed. Reapplication Process: If a candidate is not selected within one week, the application will expire, and the candidate will have to apply again and submit the fee for the following week. This process will continue on a weekly basis for a maximum of three weeks, provided seats are available.

chunks.text: Home Programs Associate Degree Program Associate Degree Program ADP Opening in 33 days Details Disciplines Fees Important Dates Downloads FAQs Eligibility Calculator The Associate Degree Program (ADP) at UET Lahore is a two-year undergraduate qualification offered across multiple disciplines. It is designed primarily for students who have completed a Diploma of Associate Engineering (DAE) and wish to formalize and expand their technical education within a university framework. The program bridges the gap between vocational training and full degree-level education by introducing students to engineering fundamentals, applied sciences, and discipline-specific coursework at the undergraduate level. The curriculum is carefully structured to recognize the practical background that DAE students bring while strengthening their theoretical and analytical capabilities. Students who successfully complete the ADP and meet the required academic merit may be considered for lateral entry into the third year of a relevant Bachelor of Engineering program, allowing them to continue toward a full degree without repeating foundational coursework.

chunks.text: Home Programs Master Master MS Closing soon Overview Disciplines Fees Important Dates Downloads FAQs Eligibility Calculator UET Lahore offers a range of postgraduate master's programs across multiple departments, catering to engineers and scientists who wish to deepen their expertise, pursue specialized research, or advance their professional standing. Programs are accredited by PEC and NCEAC where applicable, ensuring they conform to recognized quality benchmarks at the postgraduate level. Programs are available in both coursework-based and thesis-based modes, allowing students to choose a path aligned with their career goals. The coursework mode is suited to professionals seeking structured learning and advanced technical knowledge in a specific domain, while the thesis mode is designed for those who wish to engage in original research under the supervision of experienced faculty. The curriculum at the master's level introduces students to the latest developments in their respective fields, advanced methodologies, research tools, and critical analysis techniques.

chunks.text: Home Programs Ph.D Ph.D Ph.D Closing soon Overview Disciplines Fees Important Dates Downloads FAQs Eligibility Calculator The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) is the highest academic degree offered at UET Lahore and is available across multiple departments in engineering and applied sciences. It is a research-intensive program designed for individuals who wish to make an original and significant contribution to knowledge in their chosen field. The program typically spans three to five years depending on the nature and scope of the research undertaken. Each PhD student works under the close supervision of one or more faculty members who are active researchers in the relevant discipline. The doctoral journey involves an extensive review of existing literature, the development of a novel research question, the design and execution of experiments or studies, and the analysis and interpretation of results. Candidates are required to publish their research findings in HEC-recognized, peer-reviewed journals and to present their work at national and international academic conferences. The program concludes with the submission and defense of a doctoral dissertation before an evaluation committee.
